Commentary.Commentary: Once Finch fell, Marsh took the onus of runs scoring onto him. He took a liking to Adil Rashid and hit him for 25 runs in one over. He went onto score his second ton of the series and while he was batting the visitors looked like crossing 320. But it wasn't to be, Willey was exceptional at the death as his three wicket over changed the scenario. He finished with figures of 7-0-43-4 and was the pick of the bowlers along with Mark Wood. The target though is still a stiff one especially on a wicket which is a touch two-paced. The English batters though are in exceptional form and will back themselves to chase this down. Will the hosts go 4-0 up in the series or will the away side's bowlers come to the fore. Join us in a while to find out.

What a roller coaster innings this has been! Australia would be happy with their effort. Aaron Finch and Travis Head started cautiously and chipped away at runs with ease. The former was looking to play through the innings and allowed his partner to take centre stage. Head once again looked fluent as he brought up his second consecutive fifty but could not make it big. Then Shaun Marsh came out to the middle. He started slowly but supported Finch well, who got to a well-deserved century. He though, could not add to his ton.
Another full ball and driven to mid off. Both the batsmen are adamant to take two and completes it with a dive. An excellent last over by Willey, just six from it sees Australia end on 310/8.
Full outside off, Willey creams it through covers and scampers for a single. This is the highest ODI total at this venue.
The ball sneaks through the gap between bat and pad and beats the batsman.

Back of a length delivery into the batsman, Lyon goes for the pull but fails to get good connection as the ball goes off the top edge. Fielders from the deep mid-wicket comes in to take take the catch and so does Willey but no one could reach the ball. Two runs are taken in the end.

OUT! On a fuller length, from around the wicket. Willey rolls his fingers on this one. The batsman looks to play it across the line and hit it over the mid-wicket region but misses and the ball hits him on his back leg. The bowler appeals and the umpire raises the finger straightaway. Reviews are available but Paine chooses against it. Australia lose their 8th while Willey takes his fourth.
Driven to long on off the fuller ball. One run taken.
Yorker outside off and Richardson manages to get it to the fielder at backward point. He takes strike with this single.
Full, outside off, Tim drives it through covers and takes a single. Not good for Australia. Couple of wickets has taken the fizz out off their innings at the fag end.
Wide! Too straight and down the leg side. Wide signaled by the umpire.
Yorker on off. What an over this has been till now. Paine looks to get under but gets the toe end of the bat to the bowler.
Another full ball and Richardson does well to dig it out to the on side and run a quick single.
Yorker this time. The batsman looks to carve it out but gets an under edge to the keeper for nothing.
Full on the leg stump, Paine fails to make connection and gets hit on his pads. The ball rolls to the leg side and one run is taken. 300 is up for Australia with this single.
Mark Wood is back to bowl the penultimate over.
A dot to end an excellent over! England needed this especially after the pounding Rashid received in the last over. It is very full on middle, Richardson jams it out to the bowler.
Jhye Richardson strides out to the middle.

OUT! Another one bites the dust! Third in the over for Willey. He bowls a length ball around off, Neser makes room and tries to cut but he only manages to get a faint edge on it. Buttler behind the stumps makes no mistake.
Slightly shorter on middle, Neser pulls it through mid-wicket and runs two.
No hat-trick! It is a full ball on the stumps, a good one by Willey. Paine watchfully drives it towards mid off for a run.
Michael Neser walks out to face the hat-trick ball.

OUT! What a catch! The scorecard will have Overton's name on it but it is Roy who has to be given all the credit. A slower ball by Willey is launched towards the latter at long on. He runs to his left and takes it. He then realises his momentum is taking him over the ropes and hence throws it up in the air towards Overton who comes running towards him from deep mid-wicket. He completes it to give Willey his second wicket in consecutive balls. Marsh walks back after playing another magnificent innings. However, England will be pleased to see the back of him as this could easily make a difference of 10 to 20 runs to the final score.
Marsh is a goner! The umpires though have gone upstairs to check if the catch is clean.
Tim Paine walks out to the middle.

OUT! Carey holes out! Willey gets his first! A low full toss on the leg stump, not the easiest of balls to put away and  Carey just found out why. He tries to get underneath it but is not able to. He lofts it towards deep mid-wicket where Overton comes running in and takes it easily. The good thing though for Australia is the batsmen have crossed and Marsh is on strike.

SIX! Going, going and gone! What a way to bring up a century. Marsh has punished Rashid here and has given his team a push when needed. Gets a flighted ball around leg and the left-hander gets under it and powers it over the mid-wicket boundary. 25 runs off the 47th over.
Bowls another half tracker and Marsh Pulls it again. The ball goes to deep mid-wicket and two runs are taken.

FOUR! WOW! This isn't more than a power punch through cover but the connection is so sweet that the ball has raced to the boundary. Rashid corrects his length and drags it back but Marsh is into his zone.
Faster one from Rashid and pulled off the back foot to the deep mid-wicket region for another two.
FOUR! Fierce cut from Marsh and the placement is superb. The ball goes in the gap and races to the fence through backward point.

SIX! Oh Marshy! He is running to his century like a bull. Gets a flighted googly on the stumps. The swing of the bat is beautiful and it meets the ball from the middle. The ball goes over the mid-wicket boundary and into the crowd. Marsh is upping the ante in the last couple of overs.
Wide! The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for the batsman. Wide signaled by the umpire.

FOUR! Innovative stuff from the new man, Alex Carey. Shuffles across his stumps, gets low on knees and lifts the ball over the short fine leg fielder. The ball races to the fence and 13 runs are taken off the Willey's over.
Too straight, worked to the leg side for another single.
Slower delivery from David and the batsman top edges it behind the bowler for a single.
Leg Bye! Similar line and length from Willey. Marsh gives charge to work it down the long leg region but misses it and gets hit on the pads. One run is stolen.
Again full but down the leg side. The batsman tries to get bat onto it but the ball hits his pad and goes behind to the keeper.

SIX! Reload and... Bang! What a powerful strike from Marsh. He has cleared the boundary so easliy. Full on off, Marsh gets under the ball and hits it way over the bowlers head. The fielders are turned into spectators and the spectators into fielders. Good start to the over.

NOT OUT! Umpire's call and the review has been retained! Rashid tosses this one up on middle, Carey goes down on one knee and tries to sweep but the ball bounces a touch more and spins into the batsman. Alex misses and is struck on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Rashid asks his captain to review and Morgan signals the 'T'. Replays show it to be umpire's call and hence, the on-field call stays.
David Willey is back into the attack.
Review time! A huge appeal for an LBW against Carey has been given not out. Rashid likes it and he wants it to be taken upstairs. Seems to be missing.
Tucked on the leg side for a run.
The leg spinner, it is pulled to deep square leg for a run.
Alex Carey is the new man in.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Rashid gets Agar once again! The googly does the trick as it is tossed outside off, spins away. Ashton goes back and tries to cut. The ball takes the outside edge and goes into the gloves off the keeper. He whips the bails off as he starts appealing and even before the umpire can raise his finger. Agar starts walking back. Australia losing their way here towards the end.
Sees the batsman coming down the track and shortens his length. Agar drives it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Drilled! Rashid flights it up and bowls it a touch full. The spin now is out of contention. Agar slams it past the bowler and the ball crosses the fence.
Rolls his fingers and bowls a slower one. Agar is early into his shot and gets an inside edge onto his pads. The ball goes to the off side and a single results.
Back of a length around off, punched down the mid off region and runs a single.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. One run added to the total.

FOUR! Another short delivery from Wood, testing Agar who throws his bat at it. He looks to pull it but gets it off the upper edge and the ball races to the fine leg boundary. 7 runs off the over already.
Touch too straight on the pads, Marsh flicks it to the leg side. One run added to the total.

Short and into the body and Marsh goes after it with hard hands. The ball hits the upper edge and lobs in the air behind the umpire. No one there to catch it and two runs taken in the end. Shaun is looking to force his way through but not getting too many from the middle.

FOUR! A welcome boundary for Agar and Australia. Tossed up around leg and the batsman gets down on his knee to sweep it. Mark wood from square leg runs to his left to cut the boundary but makes a mess of in the end. A boundary after 23 deliveries.
Driven through mid-on by the batsman. They pick up a single.

Not Out! Clever from Rashid. He sees Marsh coming down the track, gets his length back and pushes it through as well. The ball rushes him as he tries to hit it across and misses. His foot was dragged outside the line for just a few seconds but he got back in time. The keeper flicks the bails in a flash and appeals. The replays shows that Marsh came back in time and saves his wicket.
Third umpire has been called up for a stumping decision. Marsh is the man in question. Buttler does not seem too excited.
Leg spinner around middle and off, Agar drives it through covers. One run taken.
The batsman drives the ball straight down the ground and straight to the bowler.
Flighted around off and the batsman slog it down to mid on for a single.
Adil Rashid is back for another spell.
Pulls the short ball to square leg region and keeps strike for the next over.
Keeps it on a back of a length and Agar punches it through the cover region. One run added to the total.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Drags back his length back and the batsman plays it through point region for a single.
A touch full and drives it to mid off.
Back of a length from Wood and worked to mid-wicket for nothing.
Tossed around off, Marsh comes down the track and drives it to long on. He keeps strike for the next over.
Pushed through and tucked to the legs side. One run results.
Tight line and length from Ali. Keeps it between the stumps and flights it up. The batsman comes forward and pushes it to the cover fielder.
Touch short and outside off, Marsh dabs it through the point region. Another single.
Gets forward and drives it to covers for nothing.
Faster one on off, Agar tucks it sweeper cover and runs a single.
He gets off the mark from the very first ball he faces. On a length around off, Agar guides it through backward point for a run.
Powerplay 3 signaled by the umpire. Now 5 fielders can be placed outside the circle.
Ashton Agar is promoted up the order.

OUT! Timber! Second in the over for Mark Wood and he is absolutely delighted. Once again it is the skid on the delivery which does Stoinis in. Mark comes running in and angles this into the off stump from a length. Marcus instead of playing forward goes back and tries to keep it out. The ball stays a touch low which proves to be Stoinis's undoing. He is late to get his bat down. It sneaks through and shatters the stumps behind. Marcus once again walks back cheaply and England are right back into the game.
Fuller on the pads, Marsh flicks it through backward square leg and gets to the other end.
Goes fuller on off, Marsh strokes it to mid off.
On a length around off, this one holds its line. Stoinis tries to defend but the ball goes off the edge down to third man for a run. Marcus gets off the mark in unconvincing fashion.
Marcus Stoinis makes his way out to the middle.

OUT! GONE! Century and out for Finch! Timely wicket for England and it is Wood who provides the breakthrough! This is bowled on a length around off, from wide of the crease. It pitches and skids through. Finch is beaten by pace as he tries to flick, he misses and gets hit low on the pads. The players appeal and the umpire straightaway raises his finger. Finch does not even think about reviewing it as he knows it is plumb. Hawk Eye confirms the same. Nevertheless, a brilliant innings by Aaron comes to an end. He has now laid the foundation for the ones coming in to capitalize. Can they? We will have to wait to watch.
FOUR! Touch short and Marsh pulls it away to the mid-wicket region. An expensive over from the Moeen Ali and Marsh has taken full use of it. 13 off the over and two set batsmen in the middle.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. A spirited effort by the fielder to save runs for his team.

Hangs back and pushes it through covers. A century for Aaron Finch and it's his sixth in the ODIs. He has played sensibly and anchored the fragile looking batting line up of Australia. He needs to stay till the end and take Australia to a big score.
Faster one and worked through the point region. Finch calls for two and the non-striker obliges. Two runs are taken and he is just one shy of his hundred.
Similar line and length and almost a copy paste stuff from the batsman as well. One run is taken down the ground.

SIX! Dancing shoes are on for Marsh. Beautiful swing of the willow from the left-hander. Flighted around middle and off, the batsman comes down the track in a fizzy and launches it over over the bowler's head. What a way to bring up a half-century. Australia needs him to bat long.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
FOUR! Easy runs for the right-hander. Too full and down the leg side, Finch flicks it and works it past the keeper. He moves closer to his hundred.
Full outside off, Marsh drives it through covers and changes strike.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman for nothing.
Dishes this one on a fullish length, Marsh works it to the leg side and a brace is taken.
On the leg stump, Aaron flicks it with a wristy shot and gets a single.
Mark Wood is back into the attack.
Defensive from Ali. Touch short and the batsman works it to backward point. Another run to end the over.
Played to the point region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Moves back and works it to the square leg region. One run taken and the 100-run stand is up. Second of the innings and the two will look to accelerate now.
Punches it back to the bowler for nothing.
Flatter on the stumps, Finch stays back and plays it off the back foot.
Drives it through covers for a single.
SIX! The debutant is taken to the cleaners by the opener. Another half tracker and pulled in front of mid-wicket for a maximum. Such a clean hit this one.
Straying on the pads. Marsh tucks it off his pads and changes strike.
The batsman works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Bang! Aaron Finch is the name. He is getting into his usual now. Gets a short ball into his zone and pulls it away to the mid-wicket region. The ball races to the fence.
Short and into the batsman who pulls it straight to the fielder at mid-wicket. One run taken.
The batsman failed to make contact and was hit low on the pads.
Keeps it between the sticks and Marsh flicks it off his pads. One more run to end the over.
Played to the point region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Flighted, driven through mid on for a single.
FOUR! Sweeps and sweeps it fine. A gentle loosener down the leg stump, Marsh gets nicely on top of the delivery and strokes it fine. The ball races to the fence for another boundary.
Touch too straight from Ali and worked to the leg side for a single.
Finch has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
A short delivery into the body, worked away to the leg side and two runs taken.
Stays back and punches it back to the bowler for nothing.

FOUR! Lovely! Finch has played through the line and hits it nonchalantly over the infield. The ball bounces just inside the boundary and four runs are added to the total. He needs to play through the innings for the sake of Australia.
Bouncer from Craig. Marsh goes for the pull, gets the top edge down the fine leg region and takes a single.
On a good length around leg, Shaun works it to mid-wicket and scampers for two.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Finch opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Finch dabs it to the long on region for another single.
Touch short outside off, Marsh works it behind point and takes a single.
Flatter around the leg stump, Marsh misses the flick.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Good length on off, Finch pushes it through covers and runs a single.
Down the leg side, Finch works it fine down the leg side and runs two.
Works it against the angle through mid-wicket for a run.
Good length on off, this one comes back in sharply. Finch gets it off the inner half towards the leg side and the batsmen take a quick run.

NOT OUT! The dive saves Marsh! This is on the shorter side. Finch pulls it towards fine leg. Rashid there gets to the ball. The batsmen run one and now go for a second. Marsh is late in responding and Rashid throws it at his end. Morgan collects the ball and whips the bails and appeals. The umpire takes it upstairs. Replays roll in and they show Marsh to be in.
An appeal for a run out has been taken upstairs. It is the at the non-striker's end and Marsh is the man in question. The England players do not seem confident.
Craig Overton is back for another burst.
Floats this one around off and middle, the right-hander tucks it to the leg side and takes a single to end the over.
Pushed to the cover fielder for nothing.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Good stuff from the Aussies. Finch works it to deep square leg and calls for two. His partner obliges and two are taken.
No spin on this one. Finch flicks it off his pads from his crease.
Flighted around off, Marsh comes forward and pushes it through cover region. One run taken.
Plants his foot down and presents the full face of the bat to keep it out.
Touch shorter this time and worked away with a wristy shot for one.
Nice looking shot to the leg side but finds the fielder.
Flights this one on off, tucked to the leg side for nothing.
Tossed up around middle and off, Marsh gets down the track and tries to play it through the on side. The ball hits his pad and some appeal from the keeper. Umpire is not interested.
Gets back and punches it through cover region. One run added.
Gets behind the line and keeps it out off the front foot.
Flatter around the pads and Aaron tucks it to the leg side. One run added to the total and it brings up the 50-run partnership for these two.
Loopy around off and middle, driven down the ground for another single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Another two through the cover region. Better timing on this.
Moeen Ali is into the attack. Flighted around off and Marsh drives it through the cover region. Sam Billings at sweeper cover dives and saves two for his team.
SIX! Finchy getting into his rhythm now. Picks the googly up early and picks it up and over the long on region for a maximum.
Comes down the track and takes a single from the long on region.
The batsman drives this through the covers. They pick up a single.
Flighted around middle and leg, Finch plays it to the leg side.
Flatter and tucked away to the square leg region. One run added to the total.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. Joe Root bowls out with figures of 10-0-44-0, not bad for a part timer.
Marsh dabs it to the cover region and takes a single.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Similar delivery from Root, Marsh moves back a touch and taps it to the off side for nothing.
Corrects his line and keeps it between the stumps. Blocked from the crease.
Last over for Joe Root. A touch short on leg, Marsh tucks it to backward square leg and takes two.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
The batsman dances down the track. The batsmen have run through for a single from long on.
Comes down the track but doesn't get bat on it and gets hit on the pad outside leg.
Tossed up on middle and leg, punches it back to the bowler.
Missed a chance here. Down the leg from Rashid, Marsh sweep but finds the fielder at short fine leg.
Flighted one outside off, taps to the off side and changes strike.

50 for Finch now! He goes back to the batting position he prefers and scores a half ton. He works it through mid-wicket and gets to the other end. Raises his bat and acknowledges the applause by the crowd. The job though, is only half done now.
Pushes it through covers for a run.
Flighted ball on off, Marsh lunges forward and defends it.
Flatter on off, it is pushed to covers.
Works it around the corner for a run.
Down the leg side, Finch flicks it to the short fine leg fielder.
A good end to the over by Rashid! The googly outside off, Marsh lunges to defend but is beaten by the away turn.
Floats it up on middle, Marsh finds the fielder at mid on.
Eases this through covers and gets to the other end.
SIX! Enough of singles, says Finch. He picks the googly and swings it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie. First of the game and it has come in the 24th over.
The googly on middle, it is tucked to mid-wicket.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. One run added to the total.
Slightly shorter outside off, Marsh cuts it through point for a run.
Fires this one down the leg side and the umpire signals a wide.
A full toss on middle, Finch is happy to flick it through square leg and take one.
Gives it air on middle, Marsh eases it down to long on for a run.
Another single as Finch works it through the leg side.
Slower through the air on off, Marsh pushes it through covers and takes a run.
Tucks it through square leg for a run.
The wrong 'un on middle, Marsh works it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Swept and swept fine! There is just one fielder for that shot and Marsh manages to beat him! Goes down on one knee and sweeps it through backward square leg for a boundary.
The googly on middle, Marsh keeps it out.
Fires it on off, Finch goes back and punches it through covers for a run.
Uses his feet and once again hits it hard towards the bowler. Rashid again misfields and this time concedes a run.
Flatter on middle, Marsh pushes it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up around middle and leg, Finch blocks it.
The batsman has nudged the ball fine down the leg side.
Hangs backs and taps it to vacant point region. One run taken.
Similar delivery, blocked off the front foot for nothing.
Loopy outside off, Marsh punches it to short cover.
Slower through the air on middle, Finch works it to the on side and takes a single.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single. End of a successful over for England.
The leg spinner, Marsh with the turn flicks it through mid-wicket and gets to the other end.

In the air... but just wide! Beautifully bowled! The googly outside off, Marsh tries to stroke it through the off side but the ball turns. He gets an outside edge which goes uppishly towards point. The fielder there dives but can't get to it. The batsmen take two.
Marsh uses his feet and hits it hard towards the bowler who fumbles but no runs conceded.
Floats it up on off, Marsh strokes it to mid off.
Shaun Marsh is the new man in.

OUT! Rashid draws first blood! But Head just can't believe what he has done. It was a nothing delivery, short and the leg spinner on middle. Head could have probably hit it anywhere he wants but what does he do? He goes back, pulls it right off the middle but straight to the man at deep mid-wicket where David Willey accepts an easy catch. He looks at the skies in disbelief and then starts to trudge off after yet another start. Rashid too can't believe his luck. He though, won't care as he breaks the 101-run stand.
Slightly shorter outside off, Head cuts it through point and gets to the other end.
100 up for Australia as Finch tucks it through mid-wicket and takes one.
FOUR! Finally Finch gets one away! A poor ball by Root and Aaron makes him pay. Down the leg side, Finch sweeps it very fine through fine leg for a boundary. Partnership is one short of 100.
Tucks it around the corner with the angle for a run.
Works it around the corner with the turn and runs a single.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. They pick up a single.
Finally he does what I wanted him too. Tosses this one up on middle, he does not get any purchase though off the surface. Finch lunges and blocks it out.

Mix up but no harm done. The googly on middle, Finch picks it and works it to square leg. He sets off for a run but is sent back by his partner at the right time. The fielder there throws it to the keeper who whips the bails off but Finch is in.
Quicker on off, Head punches it down to long off for another single. Rashid should maybe try and toss it up a little just to see if he gets some purchase off the surface.
Flat again, no turn as of yet for Rashid. Finch goes back and pushes it down to long off for the third single in the over.
Tosses it up on off, Head punches it to long off for a run.
Starts with a slider on middle, Finch punches it down the ground for a run.
Adil Rashid is into the attack.
Floats it up on leg stump, Finch does what he has been doing till now. Work it through the leg side and retain strike for the next over.
The arm ball on middle, it stays a touch low. Head does well to ease it down to long on and gets to the other end.
Dances down the track and also makes room. He smashes it to the man at covers where Roy makes a good stop.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Slower through the air down the leg side. Finch once again fails to find the gap and sweeps it straight to short fine leg.
Fires it on off, Finch pushes it to mid off.
Back of a length on off, Finch gets it off the outer half, past the diving fielder at point for a run. He moves onto 25 and has faced 40 balls for those runs.
On the pads, Head uses his wrists and flicks it to fine leg for a run. He moves onto 57.
Hits the length hard on off, Head pushes it to mid off.
Uses his feet and flicks it through mid-wicket only for a single.
Shorter in length on off, Finch pushes it to covers.
Back of a length on off, Finch defends it back to the bowler.
Smart bowling! This is faster and flatter on middle, Head at the very end gets his bat down in time and keeps it out.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Once again this is worked through mid-wicket and Finch gets to the other end.
Slower through the air on middle, Finch clips it to mid-wicket. Do not remember him playing  a shot on the off side to Root.
Dances down the track and pushes it through mid off for a run.
Again, Finch is happy to work it around for singles as he tucks this one through mid-wicket.
A dot to end! A good over by Overton, just 4 from it. This is pushed to the man at mid off.
Just behind a length and on off, Head guides it to point who has a needless shy at the non-striker's end. He though misses.
Stands tall and pushes it off the back foot to the man at mid off.
This time to the left of the fielder at deep square leg as Head pulls this one and runs another two.
Slightly shorter in length, Head goes back and whips it through mid-wicket and runs two.
Back of a length on off, Head punches it to the man at short cover.
Flatter on off, Head punches it through covers and takes a run. The partnership between the two is now 25 short of 100.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and connects.
Quicker on the pads, Finch clips it through the leg side and is happy with another single.

Fifty for Head. Consecutive ones for him. He strokes this to long off and gets to the other end to get to that milestone. He failed to make it big the last time but this time he would surely be eyeing the three-digit mark.
Slower through the air on middle, Finch goes back and whips it through mid-wicket for a run.
The batsman dances down the track. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Slightly fuller on off, Head pushes it towards mid off and gets to the other end.
This is pushed to the man at mid on for a quick run.
This time he bowls it right on the off stump and lands it on a length. Finch lunges forward and keeps it out.
Overton struggles to adjust to the right and left combination as he bowls this on the pads to the right hander. Finch flicks it through square leg and takes two.
Slightly shorter in length outside off, Head chops it to point and sets off for a run. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
BEAUTY! Excellent use of the angle there. Goes wide of the crease and bowls it on middle, it pitches and then moves away. Head has to play at it but is beaten by the movement away.
Three singles to end the over! Head gets to the pitch of the ball and clips it through the leg side to retain strike.
Finch flicks it through mid-wicket and rotates strike.
This time does not try anything expansive and nudges it through mid-wicket for a run.
Head uses his feet but does not get to the pitch of the ball. He still goes ahead with the heave. Luckily for him he gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Flatter on off, Head pushes it to covers.
Bowls it on the pads, Finch tucks it around the corner and gets to the other end.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled! England can now have 4 fielders outside the ring till the 40th over.

FOUR! A boundary to begin his first over and a boundary to end it. Overton is guilty of bowling it too full this time outside off. Head times it through covers and the ball races away. 12 runs from Craig's first. An expensive start from him.
On a length around off, kept out.

FOUR! Almost got his first ODI wicket! Another once which is on the shorter side. The line though is much closer to the off pole. Head once again tries to cut but he gets a bottom edge which goes agonizingly close past the off pole, past the diving keeper and into the fine leg fence.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Another short ball outside off but this time he gets it to bounce a touch more. Head once again tries to cut but is done in by the extra bounce.

FOUR! Welcome to ODI cricket Overton! He starts off with a short and wide delivery outside off. Head stands tall and slaps it through point. The fielders did not even bother chasing it as it got to the fence in no time. 50 up for Australia and the good thing for them is, they haven't lost a wicket.
The debutant, Craig Overton is into the attack.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Lovely use of the feet! He dances down the track, gets to the pitch of it and times it through covers for another boundary.
Nudges it to mid-wicket with the angle.
Fires this on middle, Head goes back and works it to mid-wicket.

Fuller on the pads. Finch goes for the sweep but misses to get hit on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire shakes his head. In the meantime the ball rolls towards short fine leg and the batsmen run a leg bye.
Turns it around the corner with the turn.
Joe Root is into the attack.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region.
FOUR! Crisp! Another ball right in the zone of Head. Full and outside off, he plants his front foot ahead and caresses it through covers for a boundary.
On the middle stump, Finch hops and tries to flick. He gets an inside edge onto his pads. The ball rolls towards the off side and the batsmen run a single.
Goes fuller and gets some inward movement. Finch gets behind the line and defends it.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
Back of a length on off, defended off the back foot.

Changes the angle and goes around the wicket. Angles it on the pads. A batsman of Head's caliber won't miss out as he flicks it through backward square leg and finds the fence. Another expensive over, 10 from it and 19 from the last two.
Goes wide of the crease and bowls it on the pads, Head flicks it through square leg and runs two.
Good change in length by the bowler. A bumper. Head ducks under it.
On the pads, Head misses out on an opportunity to score back-to-back boundaries as he is struck on the pads while attempting the flick. It rolls towards the keeper, Head wants a run but is sent back.
FOUR! Beautiful! His second boundary through that region! Wood bowls it very full on middle, Head just puts bat to it and the ball races through mid on and gets to the fence.
Back of a length on off, defended to point. Wood falls over in his followthrough. Seen him go over quite a few times in this series.
On the middle stump, worked to mid-wicket. A dot to end the over but a good one for Australia, 9 from it. They are off to a decent start here.
Shortens his length and also bowls it closer to the off stump. Finch mistimes it to covers.
FOUR! A gift for Finch! A half-volley outside off. Aaron says thank you very much and cover drives it for a boundary. Second from the over.
Angles this into the pads, Head flicks it to deep square leg and gets to the other end.
FOUR! This one was right off the middle. Excellent shot! On a length around middle, Head shows the full face of the bat and punches it through mid on for a boundary.
The pitch seems to be on the slower side here. As Head tries to drive it on the up. He however, does not get it off the middle and it goes towards the man at mid on.
Goes back to bowling length on off, Finch defends it to covers.
Goes very full but on the pads, Finch misses the flick and is struck on the front pad. The players make a muted appeal but the umpire shakes his head.
Better to the right hander as he bowls it on off, Finch defends it onto the ground.
Once again too straight. it is easy for Head as he tucks it through mid-wicket and crosses over.
Straighter in line and on a fuller length. Head flicks it through mid-wicket and bags a brace.
Works it around the corner with the angle and gets to the other end.
A pacey short ball on middle, Finch evades it. It is above the batsman's head and the umpire signals it as a wide.
Yes he can! He bowls it on a length and attacks the stumps. Head blocks it out.

The cutter on the pads, Head tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The players make a huge appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Too high I feel. So 4 dots after the boundary off the very first ball. A good comeback by the bowler, can he end it well?
Outside off, the batsman need not play at those.
The batsman gets a bottom edge on that one
Fuller on off, it is strokes to the man at mid off.
FOUR! Bad start by Willey, bowls it short and also offers width outside off. Head takes full toll of it as he cuts it through cover-point and the ball races away.
A dot to end which means it is a maiden! On a length around off, defended. Could have easily been a wicket-maiden. Nonetheless, a good over by Wood.

In the air... caught, NO! That has been put down but what an effort by Hales. That would have been a screamer had he taken it. This is bowled short and on middle, it sits up to be hit. Finch goes back and pulls it right off the middle towards short mid-wicket. Hales there stretches his right hand out and almost takes it but drops it when he falls onto the ground. That had to stick. Nevertheless, he saves a boundary there.
Shortens his length on off, Finch goes back and blocks it onto the ground. Good over so far by Wood.
Once again attacks the off pole, no swing on offer. Finch lunges and defends it to mid off.
Bowls it on a length on off, defended.
On the shorter side, Finch hops and tries to pull but misses to get hit on the thigh pad.
A good end to the over by Willey. He bowls it on a length around off, kept out.
Fuller in length on off, Finch leans into it and strokes it through covers. It beats the diving man at covers and the batsmen get three.

Slightly wider outside off, wanting the batsman to get drawn into playing a false stroke. Willey is successful in doing so as Head goes after it away from his body. He gets it off the inner half through the leg side and the batsmen run one.
On a length and around off, kept out.

Once again gets some shape into the batter but the line is wrong. It is down the leg side. Finch misses the flick and is hit on the pads. The ball rolls towards the keeper and the batsmen run a leg bye.
Swing! That too, has come in late. On a length around middle, this one comes back in sharply. Finch is surprised by it and fails to put bat to it. He is struck high on the thigh pad.
David Willey to bowl from the other end.
Shorter in length on middle, Head works it to the man at mid on. A good first over for Australia.
Bang on to the left hander! On off and on a length, the perfect line. Head can't do a lot with it as he defends it onto the ground.
Back of a length around off, Finch off the back foot guides it down to third man and gets to the other end.
Better from Wood! On a length around off, Finch does not fiddle with it.

Not a good start by Wood! The first one was short and on the body. This is on a similar length and way outside off. Finch does well to reach it but it goes off the bottom part of the bat towards covers.

FOUR! What a start for Finch as well as Australia. He needs no sighters as he pounces at this short ball. Pulls it all along the ground and the ball races away to the backward square leg fence. A boundary from the first ball, a strike rate of 400 for Finch.

We are all set to get underway! Out come the openers, Travis Head and Aaron Finch. The latter is back to the position he prefers in the 50-over format. Mark Wood will open the bowling England. Here we go...

TOSS - Australia win the toss and elect to bat. A total of three changes for them, Alex Carey, Michael Neser and Nathan Lyon come in for Andrew Tye, D'Arcy Short and Glenn Maxwell. England have a debutant in their squad as Craig Overton is handed his ODI cap. He will be replacing Liam Plunkett.

Hello and welcome to the coverage of the fourth ODI between England and Australia at Riverside Ground, Chester-le-Street. The result of the series has already been decided but it shouldn't stop either of the two teams from giving their all. The hosts have been resolute and relentless in their approach and would look to sweep the Kangaroos away. While Australia would like to win this one to save their pride. Will Australia win their first game of the series or will England blow them away again? Catch us for the live action in a short while.
